messages.title: A premium tan service — and a second revenue moment after the appointment
messages.preview: Trial the professional formula on a real client before you decide.
messages.headline: A premium tan is one appointment. The client relationship can continue after it.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
I’m reaching out because {{BUSINESS_NAME}} looks like the kind of {{BUSINESS_TYPE}} that cares about the finished result, not just the service on the day.

Sunless by Jimmy Coco brings a natural-looking bronze result, a named service you can present as premium, and a focused aftercare edit for clients who ask how to keep their glow looking good between visits.

items: A treatment that can sit confidently in your premium service menu.
A relevant aftercare recommendation when the client is happiest with the result.

blocks.html: Eligible UK professional partners can request a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample, shipped free. Test it on a real client before deciding anything wider.
Or reply TRIAL and we will keep it straightforward.

messages.title: The result is what gives a premium tan its value
messages.preview: Natural-looking colour, a repeatable professional method and a stronger consultation conversation.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: A premium service has to look worth booking again.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
The real test of a professional tan is how the client feels wearing it later: in daylight, in photographs, at an event and when they decide whether to book again.

Malibu Professional Spray is a universal bronze, 10% DHA formula with a stated 6–8-hour development window. Professional guidance recommends under 35 ml for a full-body application and confirms compatibility with standard HVLP systems.
That supports a natural-looking finish and a clearer consultation conversation: the right depth and finish for the client’s plans, not simply how dark.

messages.title: £2.14 in solution cost is only the start of the salon maths
messages.preview: Use a clear solution-cost anchor, then set the service price that works for your business.
messages.headline: Start with clear product maths. Build the service around your own market.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
The current UK Malibu Professional Spray litre is listed at £60 and is designed for approximately 28 full-body tans. That gives an approximate £2.14 solution cost per tan.
That is not a profit claim and it does not tell you what to charge. It is a starting point for your own service calculation before labour, disposables, card fees, premises and tax.
The opportunity is to test whether the result, consultation and premium service story support the treatment price that works for your business, rather than competing as a generic spray tan.
Or reply NUMBERS for a human conversation using your own treatment price and operating costs.

messages.title: The retail moment is when the client sees the result
messages.preview: One client need. One useful aftercare recommendation.
messages.headline: The easiest retail conversation happens just after a client loves their tan.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
Retail works best when it solves a question the client has already asked: how do I keep this looking good until my next appointment?

items: Buff & Glow Mitt: an even-looking maintenance routine.
Self Tan Soufflé: a controlled between-appointment top-up.
A-List Glow Kit: a complete routine or giftable option.

blocks.html: The professional tan creates the first revenue moment; relevant aftercare can create a second. Trade pricing and potential retail profit are confirmed for the order quantity and partnership route before any retail plan is set.
Or reply RETAIL for the short checkout or mobile-kit playbook.

messages.title: Should I close this out for now?
messages.preview: A final note from Sunless Partnerships.
messages.headline: I’ll leave the timing with you.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},

Jimmy Coco Pro may be relevant to {{BUSINESS_NAME}} if you are looking to build a more distinctive spray-tan offer: a premium named service, clearer treatment economics and focused aftercare for clients who want to maintain the result.

items: Trial: test the complimentary 100 ml professional sample on a real client.
Numbers: discuss the service calculation using your own treatment price and operating costs.
Retail: discuss a simple three-product aftercare edit for the salon or a mobile carry kit.

blocks.html: If the timing is not right, no problem. We will close this sequence here.

messages.title: What happens after you request the trial?
messages.preview: A clear, low-commitment route from application to a first professional order.
messages.headline: Try it first. Then decide what suits your business.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
The trial is deliberately practical. Start with the professional application and we will review it, then come back to you personally.

items: Review: we check the details of your professional application.
Trial: if eligible, we send a complimentary 100 ml professional sample, delivered free.
After the trial: if you choose to continue, the minimum first order is one 1 L bottle of Malibu Professional Spray.

blocks.html: There is no obligation to move beyond the trial. It is a simple way to judge the colour, application and fit for your own service.
Or reply TRIAL and Matthew will help personally.

messages.title: Would numbers or retail be more useful?
messages.preview: Choose the commercial conversation that is most useful to your business.
messages.headline: Would numbers or retail be more useful?

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
There are two useful conversations to have before deciding whether Jimmy Coco Pro is right for your business.

items: NUMBERS: review solution use alongside the treatment price and operating costs that matter to your service. The discussion uses your own figures, not a generic margin promise.
RETAIL: talk through a concise aftercare edit that feels helpful just after a client has seen their result.

blocks.html: Reply with NUMBERS or RETAIL and Matthew will reply personally. It is a direct conversation, not an automated route.
